name: io.github.DamienDrash/iphone-mcp
title: iPhone MCP
description: See and control a real iPhone over USB or Wi-Fi: screenshots, UI tree, taps, swipes, typing, apps.

environmentVariables.name: IPHONE_MCP_UDID
environmentVariables.description: UDID of the iPhone to use when several are connected

environmentVariables.name: IPHONE_MCP_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Connection mode: auto (default), usb or wifi

environmentVariables.name: IPHONE_MCP_KEEP_AWAKE
environmentVariables.description: Keep the screen from auto-locking while connected (1 = default, 0 = off)
